title: OriDET Pack
description: This modpack is mainly for Oritech and Create Aeronautics with a sprinkle of building and cosmetic mods.
body:
This is a tech modpack that doesn't have the usual tech mods. Instead, it is centered around: 

- Oritech, which is basically a new Mekanism.
- Create, which is the (newly-made) classic steampunk tech mod.
    - This includes Create Aeronautics, so you can zip around your world in style.
- Tom's Simple Storage Mod to store all of your new metals and miscellaneous junk.

Tech obviously isn't enough; there's gotta be something to look for:

- Nature's Spirit, a relatively-new biome mod different from the usual.
- Tectonic, to amp up Nature's Spirit tenfold.
- Various YUNG's mods for structures.
- Distant Horizons to actually see your world.
- Iris Shaders to see your world
- Bosses'Rise for those who advance through the game too quick.
- Ribbits for new friends.
- Exposure to take home memories of your botched boss fights.

But alas, maybe you're a homebody, like many of our friends:

- A few furniture mods, especially Macaw's suite, to fill in your home.
- Supplementaries to deck out your home.
- Farmer's Delight to enjoy your new kitchen.
- Brewin' and Chewin' to really enjoy your new kitchen.
- Aquaculture 2 to fish all day, if you're too lazy to build a home.
- Let's Do Beachparty if you can't be bothered to fish all day.

There are also a few optimization mods, like Sodium, Lithium, and ImmediatelyFast.

This pack is intended more for our friend group, as we wanted something a bit different from the usual kitchen sink mods; not much different, but different enough to notice. As such, there may be major mod changes as we tweak the pack to our desires. However the core experience is stable enough to use in your own worlds. Thanks for reading.
